summary: gpaas-paypal preinstall beacons host identifiers to Burp Collaborator subdomain
details: On npm install, the package's preinstall script runs index.js which collects the installer's hostname, platform, architecture, home directory path, and configured DNS servers, then POSTs them via HTTPS to t4ygm1p2e1grblohe7f7nlf0krqjef24.oastify.com/hit (a Burp Suite Collaborator subdomain used as an attacker-controlled callback endpoint). The package self-describes as a dependency-confusion proof of concept; installation causes automatic exfiltration of host reconnaissance data to a third-party endpoint before any user code runs.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
